verified_title: AutoLab: An Internet-Accessible Experimental Platform for Operational World Models in Wireless Networks
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2609.14854: AutoLab: An Internet-Accessible Experimental Platform for Operational World Models in Wireless Networks
method_summary: An internet-accessible wireless experimentation platform connects robots, APs, scans and traffic through validated, scheduled experiments. Authoring and network-management execution share validation contracts; experiments preserve measurements and operational state. The contribution is grounded infrastructure rather than a completed autonomous world model.
evidence_and_limits: The paper was read; its testbed was not accessed or controlled. It does not implement our proposed packet-service estimator, and its infrastructure evidence must not be presented as our hardware evidence.
